title: Transform pipeline values
summary: PowerShell: Transform pipeline values. Multiply by 3.
introduction: ForEach-Object runs a block for each incoming value. Read the example, then check the result.

blocks.text: Open PowerShell 7. Paste one example or save it as lesson.ps1 and run pwsh -NoProfile -File lesson.ps1. No administrator access is needed.
Each current item is multiplied by 2, producing 4 and 6.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Use $_ for the current item inside the pipeline block.
